claim: R-033: an idle, supply-empty five-member camp crosses the unchanged production threshold, sends its ordinary structural pair to a local watch before a delayed real acoustic source emits, returns one matching sound report, and preserves the original sound provenance and age through native save/reload.
material_proof: Before input, the new source-bound run must falsify the retained supply-adequate control by observing the real production scheduler with drive at least 500 while the fixture supplies remain exactly zero, and must separately bind the idle five-member roster, sole road lead, no active owner, and delayed charge. The actual route is credited only when ordinary native waits produce the dispatch, local watch, C4 source event, same-run sound callback, and physical return carrying a returned_report lead whose source key and OMT match the observed sound. After that return, native save-and-quit and the declared replacement process must preserve that same report's source class/key/OMT and original observation minute; the observed age may advance only by elapsed native game time, never by fixture rewriting.
current_uncertainty: Whether the current source and drive-500 fixture retain the previously observed native route and whether its returned sound report remains durable and correctly aged across the declared replacement process.
